description: Byte-for-byte the ownership of filesys-unowned, with one word changed in /etc/nsswitch.conf: passwd and group are served by SSSD as well as by the local files. uid 4242 is now very likely a real directory account whose home this host mounts, and Plumbline opens no network socket, so it cannot ask. FILESYS-0010 must return UNKNOWN(ambiguous_system_state) here and cite the routing table. The pair with filesys-unowned is the whole test: identical disks, opposite verdicts, and the only difference is what the host says its account database is.
